title: Grand Marble Staircase
purpose: Transition and section-break imagery; ascent and gravitas motif.
story: A grand marble staircase rising under a single light — the ceremonial climb toward authority, empty and absolute.
environment: A monumental stair hall, a broad marble flight sweeping upward beneath a balustrade, the landing above in shadow.
architecture: Baroque stair-hall interior — a balustraded sweep, carved newel posts, an arched landing dissolving into gloom.
composition: The staircase ascending on a strong diagonal, a single warm light raking the treads, the upper landing held in deep negative space.
continuityNotes: Holds the set's near-black grade with one warm source and brass-on-black palette consistent with scene-01.
